message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine which statutory charge(s) apply to the fact.

The fact: Defendant Wang was sued for a contract dispute, got a civil judgment to pay 7700 yuan. He didn't comply, didn't report assets, execution notice, fine of 5000 yuan imposed, still didn't comply. After the case, he fulfilled all obligations. So the conduct: refusal to comply with civil judgment, failure to report assets, obstruction of execution. Which criminal charge? In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime of "非法处置查封、扣押、冻结的财产" (illegal disposal of seized, detained, frozen property) maybe not. There's also "徇私舞弊不移交刑事案件" not relevant. There's "拒不执行判决、裁定罪" (refusal to execute judgment) but not in the list. The list includes many crimes but not that one. However there is "非法处置查封、扣押、冻结的财产" which is about illegal disposal of property that has been seized, but here he just didn't report assets, not disposing.

Maybe "妨害公务" (obstructing official duties) could apply? He refused to comply with execution notice, which is a duty of the court. That could be considered "妨害公务" (obstructing public officials in the performance of duties). The list includes "妨害公务". Also "拒不执行判决、裁定罪" is not listed. So likely "妨害公务". Also maybe "非法持有毒品" no. "危险驾驶" no.

Thus the appropriate charge from list: 妨害公务.

Check if any other: "非法处置查封、扣押、冻结的财产" - not disposing, just not reporting. "徇私舞弊不移交刑事案件" no. "妨害作证" no. So answer: [罪名]妨害公务<eoa>
